translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat fright-qi within the skin, and the heat of the skin and flesh also rising (肌膚熱亦起), heat-red pain of the eyes, and mouth sores. Taken over a long time it communicates with the spirit-shen.
translator_notes: 肌膚熱亦起 likely 肌膚熱瘡/赤起 (heat sores rising); the reading is uncertain.
